10 He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever. (1 Chronicles 22:10 KJV)

The Lord was telling David that Solomon, David’s son, would be the one to build the Temple of God for the Lord. This promise to David that his throne would rule over the kingdom of Israel forever was certainly brought to fruit when Jesus was born and shall rule over His kingdom forever (Revelation 5:13). The name of Solomon was originally given by God to be Jedidiah, which means “beloved of the Lord”. The name Solomon means “peaceful”. Even though Solomon did fall away from God in his later years, God kept His promise to David by having Jesus born of his descendants. God always keeps His word – praise God!

This is another example to how faithful our God is, as when He makes promises and covenants in the Bible, He always keeps His word, as He can not lie (Titus 1:2). That makes us all the more sure that when His Word says we are saved, and heirs with Jesus of all God has, we can know that it will come to pass - as long as we don‘t blasphemy the Holy Ghost (Matthew 12:31-32), or fall away and become reprobate (Romans 1:28), or disobey Jesus (Hebrews 5:9). Praise our Holy God for His wonderful Words, Blessings, Promises and His integrity.
